More info here: https://github.com/prototypo/ethereum-eips-ontology/tree/main Thoughts, comments, flames, likes, stars appreciated 😅️️ Does any one have a good solution in which you all track rewards for a group of validators per epoch? Doesn’t seem to be a clean way so curious how others have been able to achieve this we probably want to start some messaging around gas limit really soon, push for 60M is increasing a bunch we did. they are pushing for 45M most likely you cannot actually tell what limit validators are pushing for ah ok so we'll only really see once it stops...
